request.style: English, warm male baritone solo, acoustic guitar, banjo, fiddle, piano, upright bass, reflective and hopeful mood, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Joseph was taken down to Egypt land
Potiphar bought him from the Ishmaelites
The Lord was with him and he prospered
His master saw the favor of the Lord

[Verse]
He put Joseph in charge of the house
And entrusted all his wealth to care
The Lord blessed the field and the home
And Joseph was handsome and well built

[Pre-Chorus]
After some time his master’s wife
Took notice of him and spoke
Come to bed with me she said
But he refused her with a voice

[Chorus]
How could I do such a great evil
And sin against God in this place
The Lord was with him in the prison
And showed him steadfast love

[Verse]
Day after day she kept at him
But he would not listen or lie
One day he came to do his work
She caught his cloak and screamed aloud

[Verse]
She told the men of the household
That he came to make sport of us
She kept his cloak until his master
Came home and heard her story

[Chorus]
How could I do such a great evil
And sin against God in this place
The Lord was with him in the prison
And showed him steadfast love

[Bridge]
His master burned with anger then
And took him to the prison cell
Where the king’s prisoners were held
And there he remained alone

[Outro]
The warden paid no attention
To anything under his care
Because the Lord was with him
And gave him success in all
